blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recently, it has been shown that vision-language models (VLMs) have a certain intrinsic understanding of time. They can estimate the temporal origin of objects and encode time along a low-dimensional, non-linear manifold inside their embedding space~\cite{tekaya2025matter}. That result is quantitative and reproducible, but the structure itself stays out of reach for end users: they cannot see it, query it with their own images, or inspect where a query lands relative to other years on the time axis. We present TimeLineXR, an interactive demonstration that turns this time axis into an explorable 3D scene. A web demo lets users upload or select images and see each placed on a color-coded 3D time axis; a Three.js WebXR scene renders the same time axis as a room-scale representation that can be grabbed, scaled, inspected, and queried by throwing image cards into it. Both clients run the same prediction pipeline against the same cached temporal index: encode the query with CLIP, project it through cosine-kernel KPCA, and snap it to the Bézier time axis. The system turns each image into a point on the time axis, so users can compare where different objects land and read off their estimated first year of appearance.Code source and reproduction steps can be found in: https://github.com/sterngefeuert/timeline-xr.
blocks.zh: 最近,有迹象表明,视觉语言模型(VLMs)对时间有一定的内在理解. 它们可以估计物体的时间来源,并沿着其嵌入空间内的一个低维的非线性多倍体来编码时间__cite{tekaya2025matter}. 这种结果是定量的和可复制的,但结构本身对于终端用户来说是无法达到的:他们无法看到它,无法用自己的图像查询它,或者检查时间轴上相对于其他年份的查询位置. 我们介绍TimeLineXR,一个交互演示,将这个时间轴变成可扩展的3D场景. 一个web演示让用户上传或选择图像,并看到每个图像被放入一个有色码的3D时间轴;一个Tree.js WebXR场景使时间轴与一个可被抓取,缩放,检查,并通过将图像卡扔入其中来询问的房间比例代表制相同. 两个客户根据相同的缓存时间索引运行相同的预测管道:用 CLIP 编码查询,通过相弦内核 KPCA 进行投影,并按到贝塞尔时间轴上. 系统将每个图像转换为时间轴上的一个点,因此用户可以比较不同对象降落的地方并读取其估计的第一年外观. 代码来源和复制步骤见:https://github.com/sterngefeuert/timeline-xr.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Temporal reasoning in images asks when an object or visual artifact first appeared
in time. In information retrieval terms, this is a query-by-example task over a
temporal index: an image query should be mapped to a year coordinate that can support
search, filtering, browsing, and comparison in multimedia collections.
blocks.zh:
图像中的时间推理 问物体或视觉文物何时首次出现
在时间。 在信息检索方面,这是一个逐个查询任务,通过一个
时间索引:图像查询应映射到能够支持的年份坐标
搜索、过滤、浏览和比较多媒体收藏。

blocks.en:
Recent work has shown that VLMs implicitly encode time along a structured,
low-dimensional axis inside their joint image-text embedding
space [ 1 ] . This time axis acts as an internal timeline:
images of objects from similar periods cluster together, and the axis progresses
chronologically from older to more recent artifacts. This is an intriguing property
that may reveal something fundamental about the expressiveness and temporal awareness
of VLMs. Yet the time axis itself has not been explored interactively: users cannot
see it, walk along it, or query it with their own images to understand where a given
artifact lands and why. Enabling this exploration is a step toward interpretability
of VLM representations, which is a topic of growing interest in multimedia
analysis [ 2 , 3 ] .

看到它,沿着它走,或者用他们自己的图像询问它 以了解一个给定的地方

分析[2,3]。

blocks.en:
To enable this exploration, we introduce TimeLineXR. The system estimates each query
image’s year of first appearance and places it on a browsable 3D representation of
the VLM’s time axis. The web frontend opens this view in any browser; the WebXR
frontend adds depth, real-world scale, and hands-on manipulation. Seeing where images
land on the time axis, and being able to move around it, compare placements, and
inspect the structure, gives users direct intuition about how the model organises time
and where its estimates agree or diverge with expectations.

As supplementary material we include a demo video that walks through the headset
exploration and estimation workflow; upon acceptance, the WebXR application will be
hosted at a public HTTPS endpoint and the Gradio web demo will be released as a
Hugging Face Space.

blocks.en:

on an interactive 3D time axis. • A zero-install WebXR interface that renders the same time axis

for the web demo and exposed through a FastAPI HTTP service for the WebXR
client.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Time-aware vision-language models. The reference method [ 1 ] uses
CLIP ViT-B/32 [ 4 ] and EVA-CLIP [ 5 ] as
representative backbones and shows that their time axis can be approximated
by a 1D Bézier curve in a kernel PCA subspace. Earlier visual time-estimation work
focused on dating historical photographs in a single visual
domain [ 6 ] and did not expose the underlying temporal
structure of the model.
blocks.zh:
时代意识视觉语言模型. 参考方法[1]
CLIP VIT-B/32 [4]和EVA-CLIP [5]作为
具有代表性的主干线,并显示其时间轴可以近似
由内核PAC子空间中的1D贝塞尔曲线. 早期的视觉时间估计工作
专注于在单一视觉中约会历史照片
域[6],没有暴露潜在的时间
模型的结构。

blocks.en: Embedding-space and retrieval interfaces. Embedding Projector [ 2 ] popularised interactive visualization of high-dimensional embeddings, but it is a generic projection viewer: it does not provide a temporal index or time estimation capabilities. TimeLineXR instead treats the time axis itself as an explorable structure that users can query with their own images, see their placement on, and browse along.
blocks.zh: 嵌入空间和检索接口。 嵌入Projector [2] 高维嵌入的普及交互式可视化,但它是一个通用的投影查看器:它不提供时间索引或时间估计能力. 时间线 XR转而将时间轴本身视为一个可探索的结构,用户可以通过自己的图像查询,查看其位置,并沿边浏览.

blocks.en:
Immersive analytics and cultural heritage. Immersive analytics studies show how spatial interaction in XR can support
reasoning about abstract data [ 3 ] , and XR is widely
used in cultural-heritage and museum contexts [ 7 ] for
situating artifacts in space and time. TimeLineXR draws on both: the time axis is easier to read when explored in space,
and users can place any image on it (vehicles, instruments, ships, mobile phones, and beyond), which makes it a good fit for museum-style exploration of how objects evolved over time. To our knowledge, no prior demonstration combines a VLM-derived time axis, live image placement, and WebXR interaction in a single package.

将文物放置在时空中. TimeLineXR同时借鉴:在空间探索时,时间轴更容易读取,
并且用户可以将任何图像(车辆、仪器、船只、移动电话等)放在上面,这使得它非常适合博物馆式地探索物体如何随时间演变。 据我们所知,任何先前的演示都无法将一个VLM衍生的时间轴,现场图像布置,以及WebXR交互在一个单一包中结合.

blocks.en: III System Overview
blocks.zh: 三. 系统概览

blocks.en:
TimeLineXR builds the time axis offline and then handles queries online
(Fig. 2 ). The fitted Bézier time axis and KPCA projection state are computed
once and reused for every query. Users submit a query either through the web upload
controls or by throwing a card in the WebXR scene; both clients run the same estimation
pipeline and return an estimated year together with a 3D coordinate on the time axis,
which the active client uses to place the image in the rendered scene. The time axis
points are the per-year text embeddings, reduced by KPCA and projected onto the
fitted curve, so a placed image lands next to the years that best match it in the
embedding space.

blocks.en: III-A Time Estimation Backend
blocks.zh: III-A 时间估计后端

blocks.en:
The time axis is extracted from the VLM following Tekaya et
al. [ 1 ] : text prompts for each year are encoded by the VLM’s
text encoder and reduced to a low-dimensional subspace via cosine-kernel KPCA.
A smooth 1D Bézier curve is then fitted through these reduced time embeddings,
and each embedding is projected onto its closest point on the curve, so the years
are arranged uniformly along it from 1700 to 2024. At query time, the image is
encoded by the same VLM, projected into the same subspace, and assigned the year
of the closest point on the curve. Figure 2 illustrates this pipeline.
blocks.zh:

al. [1]:每年的文本提示由VLM编码
文本编码器,并通过宇宙内核KPCA缩小为低维子空间。
然后通过这些缩短的时间嵌入安装一个平滑的1D贝塞尔曲线,
每个嵌入物都投射到 曲线上最接近的点上 所以这些年
从1700年到2024年统一安排 在查询时,图像是
由同一个 VLM 编码,投射到同一个子空间,并指定年份
曲线上最接近的点。 图2说明了这一管道。

blocks.en:
For TimeLineXR we reduce to a 3D projection subspace instead of the
13-dimensional subspace of the reference work, so the time axis can be rendered
directly as a navigable 3D scene. Reducing to 3 dimensions increases MAE
compared to the reference setting, as shown in Table I ;
this is expected and acceptable since spatial legibility takes priority over
benchmark accuracy in an interactive exploration tool. Users can switch between
CLIP ViT-B/32 [ 4 ] and EVA-CLIP [ 5 ] from
the web demo to observe how the choice of backbone affects the estimated year.

blocks.en: III-B Web Demo
blocks.zh: 三-B 网络演示

blocks.en:
The web demo is a Gradio application that renders the time axis as an
interactive Plotly 3D scatter (Fig. 3 ). Users upload an
image or select a bundled example; the estimated year is added to
the plot and to a running prediction table. The time embeddings, reduced to 3D and
projected onto the fitted Bézier curve, are shown as points colour-coded by year
on a viridis ramp; the curve itself is drawn as a continuous red line. The demo is a
hosted web application reachable from any browser and is the hardware-free entry point
for users without a headset.

blocks.en: III-C WebXR Application
blocks.zh: III-C WebXR 应用程序

blocks.en:
The immersive frontend is built with Three.js and the WebXR Device API and runs
unmodified in any WebXR-capable browser. Desktop browsers get an orbitable preview;
headsets enter an immersive session that first requests passthrough mixed reality
( immersive-ar ) and falls back to a dark virtual environment
( immersive-vr ). The time axis is rendered as a room-scale point cloud with a
Bézier time axis (a tube mesh) running through it. The entire scene can be grabbed,
moved, and pinch-scaled. To query it, the user takes a
card from a grabbable example shelf (or uploads a personal image) and throws it into
the scene. The throw animation is designed to overlap with the backend prediction time: the
animation lasts 0.5–1.3 s (see Table II ), which is enforced to be
long enough to cover typical prediction times on both CPU and GPU hosts, so the visitor
never sees an idle wait. Beyond masking latency, the motion gives the interaction a
physical feel, as though the user is placing the image into the time axis by hand.
The card then settles at the estimated year on the time axis. The supplementary video
was recorded on a Meta Quest 3 running the Meta Quest Browser, which is also the
device we will use for on-site presentation. Uploaded and bundled images are the
universal input path, since raw passthrough-camera access is not reliably exposed by
current headset browsers.

blocks.en: IV Demonstration Scenario
blocks.zh: 四. 示范设想

blocks.en:
The temporal structure reported in [ 1 ] exists only as numbers:
correlation scores and error metrics that summarise the time axis but never show its
shape, its dense and sparse regions, or how images attach to it. TimeLineXR makes
that structure directly inspectable, without aiming to improve estimation accuracy.
blocks.zh:
[1]中报告的时间结构仅作为数字存在:
相关分数和错误度量法总结时间轴但从未显示其
形状,它的密集和稀疏的区域, 或者图像如何与它相连。 时间线XR 制作
该结构可直接检查,而无意提高估计准确性。

blocks.en:
Users can start from either interface. In the web demo, the time axis begins empty
and images are added one at a time. Adding mobile phones across several decades, the
user watches where each attaches and whether the ordering matches expectation. Adding
objects from a different category over the same period reveals whether the model
groups images by era or by domain, a qualitative observation that aggregate metrics
cannot convey. As images accumulate the global shape becomes visible; at any point
the user can also load a pre-computed time axis from TIME10k [ 1 ] ,
populating it with hundreds of images across all six categories, and then add
their own to probe the model beyond the benchmark.
blocks.zh:

并同时添加一个图像。 在几十年中增加移动电话

他们自己去探索超过基准的模型

blocks.en:
In the XR version on a Meta Quest 3, the same structure is explored at room scale.
Walking along the axis and rotating the point cloud makes the non-linearity tangible
in a way a 2D plot cannot. The demonstration’s value is this shift: from a reported
statistic to an inspectable, navigable object.
blocks.zh:
在Meta Quest 3上的XR版本中,在室规模上探索了相同的结构.
沿着轴线走,旋转点云 使非线性有形
以某种方式 2D 情节无法。 示威的价值是这一转变:
对可检查的可导航物体的统计。

blocks.en: V Implementation Notes
blocks.zh: 五 执行情况说明

blocks.en:
The backend is implemented in Python with PyTorch, HuggingFace
Transformers, and scikit-learn; it uses frozen pre-trained encoders
and introduces no new training. The web client uses Gradio and Plotly
and will be released as a Hugging Face Space upon acceptance. The
WebXR client is served by a FastAPI/uvicorn application and rendered
in Three.js through a CDN-imported module map, so the only
client-side dependency is a WebXR-capable browser (immersive WebXR
sessions require HTTPS). Table II reports typical
end-to-end timings for the backend prediction (CLIP encode, KPCA
projection, and Bézier snap) on a CPU-only host and on a
GPU-enabled host, alongside the XR throw animation duration.

变形器,以及 scikit-learn; 它使用冷冻的前置编码器
并且不进行新的培训。 网络客户端使用 Gradio 和 Plotly
然后在被接受后作为"拥抱面空间"发布. 那个
WebXR 客户端由 FastAPI/ uvicorn 应用程序服务并交付

blocks.en: VI Future Work
blocks.zh: 六. 未来工作

blocks.en:
We see two complementary directions for future work. Technical: Meta Quest and
similar headsets limit what WebXR can access on the device; in particular,
raw passthrough-camera access is not reliably exposed today. Once that changes, we
plan to embed the live camera feed directly into the XR scene so that a
user can point their headset at a physical object and watch its position
appear on the time axis in real time, without an upload step. Lighter on-device backbones such as
MobileCLIP [ 8 ] would make this loop fully local. Applicational: we plan to deploy TimeLineXR in museums and
exhibitions [ 7 ] , where visitors can follow any chosen
collection (for instance, vehicles, mobile phones, ships, or instruments)
and see how the look of the objects changed decade by decade while
estimating the year of each item in real time.
blocks.zh:
我们认为,今后的工作有两个相辅相成的方向。 技术: Meta 查询和
类似耳机限制WebXR在设备上访问的内容;特别是,
原始的通过-摄像头接入系统今天不可靠。 一旦改变,我们
计划将现场摄像头直接装入XR场景,以便
用户可以将其耳机指向物理对象并查看其位置
实时出现在时间轴上,没有上传步骤。 更轻的干线,例如
MobileCLIP[8]将使这个循环完全本地化. 应用:我们计划在博物馆安装TimeLineXR和
展览[7],参观者可以跟随任何选定的
收集(例如车辆、移动电话、船舶或仪器)
并看物体的外观如何 改变十年,同时
实时估计每个项目的年份。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en:
TimeLineXR provides an interactive way to explore how a VLM organises time in its
embedding space. We introduced two complementary views, a browser demo and a WebXR
scene, built on a shared estimation pipeline. The demo lets users query the VLM’s time
axis with their own images and compare where in time different objects are placed. By
turning a previously statistical finding into an inspectable, navigable object, it
offers a qualitative, complementary view alongside the quantitative results of the
method it builds on.
blocks.zh:
TimeLineXR 提供了一个交互方式, 探索 VLM 如何组织时间
嵌入空间. 我们介绍了两个互补的视图,一个浏览器演示和一个WebXR
以共享估计管道为基础 演示让用户查询 VLM 的时间
轴与自己的图像并比较不同对象在时间上的位置。 以
将先前的统计结果变成可检查的可导航对象,它
提供定性和补充性观点,同时提供量化结果
方法,它继续发展。
